I love that Nique Clifford pickup for the Thunder. He was good as a rookie for the Kings in a tough spot. For whatever reason, he's fallen out of the rotation this year.

Clifford can do a lot of things, which is a requirement for OKC wings. He'll play a real role for them.

items.author: Jon Hamm
items.body_excerpt:
The Oklahoma City Thunder originally drafted Nique Clifford with the 24th pick of the 2025 NBA draft. The pick was part of the Paul George Trade Haul. 

His rights were traded to the Kings in exchange for a protected Spurs 1st rd pick in 2027.

Now OKC re-acquires him for a pair of seconds.
